question: I am 17 years old applying for my first passport, what documents do I need?

naive.answer:
Below is what the passport instruction booklet says that is relevant for a 17‑year‑old (a minor) applying for a **first** passport: | Requirement | What the booklet says | |-------------|-----------------------| | **Validity you can choose** | A minor between 15 and 18 years may apply either for a 10‑year passport **or** for a passport that is valid only until the applicant turns 18 years old【passport_instruction_booklet】. | | **Parent/guardian passport details** | In Column 3.5 you must enter the passport number (or file number, if a passport has only been applied for) of **both or either** parent or legal guardian. If a parent holds a valid passport **with the spouse’s name endorsed**, the minor’s passport can be issued **without police verification**; otherwise police verification will be required【passport_instruction_booklet】. | | **If a parent’s passport does not have the spouse’s name** | The parent must either get the spouse’s name added by re‑issuing the passport **or** furnish a marriage certificate. This speeds up processing of the minor’s passport【passport_instruction_booklet】. | | **If the applicant is a legal guardian’s child** | A court decree or order establishing the legal guardianship must be attached【passport_instruction_booklet】. | | **If neither parent holds a valid passport** | Police verification will be required after the application is submitted【passport_instruction_booklet】. | | **Form fields to fill** | • Leave the “Validity Required” column blank (the system will assign the appropriate validity)【passport_instruction_booklet】.
• Indicate the desired booklet size (36 pages or 60 pages) in Column 1.5【passport_instruction_booklet】.
• Provide full name as you want it to appear on the passport in Column 2.1【passport_instruction_booklet】. | ### What the excerpts **do not** list The booklet refers to a **complete list of documents** in *Section D – “Case No. I (B) in Table 2: List of Applicant Categories and Documents to be submitted with the application”* (and also in Section E for fee details). The specific documents (e.g., birth certificate, address proof, school/college ID, parental consent forms, etc.) are **not included** in the excerpts you provided. ### What you should do next To know the exact documents you must attach (e.g., original birth certificate, address proof, parental consent letters, school/college ID, etc.), please consult the full **Passport Seva – Application Form Instruction Booklet** (especially Section D, Table 2) or the official Passport Seva website. This will give you the complete, official checklist for a 17‑year‑old first‑time applicant.

claims.claim: A minor between 15 and 18 years may apply either for a 10‑year passport or for a passport that is valid only until the applicant turns 18 years old

If a parent’s passport does not have the spouse’s name, the parent must either get the spouse’s name added by re‑issuing the passport or furnish a marriage certificate; this speeds up processing of the minor’s passport

question: What documents does an adult Indian citizen by birth need for a fresh ordinary passport?

naive.answer:

• **Driving Licence** – listed among the identity documents that must be “valid and within the jurisdiction of the State of submission of applicant”. | 【passport_instruction_booklet】 (excerpt on Aadhaar as POI/POA) ; 【passport_instruction_booklet】 (first excerpt, item k) | | **Proof of Date of Birth** (attach **one** of the following) | • Birth Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths (must contain name of child, parents, DOB, place of birth, etc.)
• School Leaving / Transfer / Matriculation Certificate showing DOB
• Policy Bond from a public life‑insurance company showing DOB
• Service record or Pay‑Pension Order (for government servants) showing DOB
• Driving Licence (if it carries DOB)
• Election Photo Identity Card (contains DOB)
• PAN Card (contains DOB)
• Declaration from head of an orphanage/child‑care home (if applicable) | 【passport_instruction_booklet】 (excerpt “Proof of Date of Birth – attach one of the following…”) | | **Other mandatory documents for a fresh passport** | • **Self‑attested copies of the original documents** (all documents listed above must be produced in original and with self‑attested copies)
• **Photographs** (standard passport‑size photos – mentioned elsewhere in the booklet, though not quoted in the excerpts)
• **Completed passport application form** (online/print‑out)

The booklet also notes that Aadhaar “will expedite processing”【passport_instruction_booklet】 (section on Aadhaar). | | **Special cases (not needed for a first‑time adult applicant)** | • Old passport, parents’ passports, citizenship certificate, marriage certificate, adoption deed, etc. – these appear in the longer list of documents for name change, re‑issue, or other special circumstances, but are **not required** for a fresh ordinary passport. | 【passport_instruction_booklet】 (page 14 list of documents) | --- ### What the excerpts do **not** tell us The excerpts do not provide a **complete, step‑by‑step checklist** for a fresh ordinary passport (e.g., exact number of photographs, size specifications, fee amount, online application URL, declaration forms, or the “Annexure” forms that may be required for minors or special cases). **Action:** Please verify the full list of required documents, photograph specifications, fee details, and any additional declarations on the official Passport Seva website or the latest version of the *Application Form Instruction Booklet* before submitting your application.

question: What is the validity period of a private driving license in India?

naive.answer: A private driving licence is normally issued for **20 years from the date of issue or until the holder reaches 40 years of age, whichever comes first**. If the holder is already 40 years old, the licence is then issued for **10 years**, and thereafter for **5 years** on subsequent renewals【dl_new_driver_license_faq】.

claims.claim: Private driving licence is issued for 20 years from issue date or until holder reaches 40 years, whichever is earlier
If the holder is already 40 years old, the licence is issued for 10 years
Subsequent renewals are issued for 5 years

agentic.answer: A private (non‑transport) driving licence is normally issued **for 20 years from the date of issue, or up to the holder’s 40th birthday – whichever comes first**. If the holder is already 40 years old, the licence is then issued for **10 years**, and thereafter for **5 years** on subsequent renewals【dl_new_driver_license_faq】.

claims.claim: Private (non‑transport) driving licence is issued for 20 years from issue date or until the holder turns 40, whichever is earlier
If the holder is already 40 years old, the licence is issued for 10 years
Subsequent renewals after that are for 5 years each
